name: Versus
direction: Box-art portraits and a lightning-bolt versus composition.
detail: Composition: a lavish 1990s arcade versus-screen poster. Close-up Ryu on the left in a white gi and red headband, Ken on the right in a red gi with blond hair. Both fierce faces turned towards centre, clenched fists foreground, dynamic diagonal red/blue split and a bright yellow lightning-bolt VS. Painterly CEL INK arcade cabinet key-art, NOT tiny sprites. Their shoulders occupy the lower half; white sky-shaped negative space supports dramatic huge typography. Provider lettering and numbers are integral chunky angled fighter-name plaques: left "CLAUDE" then "20%" and "WEEK LEFT", right "CODEX" then "95%" and "WEEK LEFT". The percentages must be nearly as striking as the faces. Keep beautiful red-orange vs cobalt opposition, white highlights and deep black contours. Only extra title "VS".

name: Rooftop Round
direction: Pixel fighters beneath temple roofs; remaining allowance becomes the fight HUD.
detail: Composition: lovingly crafted chunky pixel art inspired by the classic Street Fighter II rooftop duel. Full-body Ryu in white gi left and Ken in red gi right face each other on a weathered temple rooftop at sunset, dramatic red sun and layered green/cobalt mountains, chunky black roof tiles. One gathers a compact blue energy orb in his cupped hands while the other braces; freeze before impact. Strong 16-bit sprite silhouettes, chunky pixel clusters rather than painterly art. Across the TOP quarter, the traditional two-player health HUD becomes remaining allowance: left CLAUDE / huge 20% / WEEK LEFT with a bar about one-fifth full, right CODEX / huge 95% / WEEK LEFT with a bar almost full. Yellow KO medallion at the centre instead of a numeric game timer. Use big white numerals and black outline. The lower three quarters remain a spectacular wide stage illustration. A couple of windblown leaves and headband ribbons give movement, no unnecessary small text.

name: Sonic Reserve
direction: Guile and the airbase; cockpit stencils and fuel gauges hold the data.
detail: Composition: Guile in green fatigues and towering blond flat-top hair launches a sweeping crescent-shaped Sonic Boom across an airbase, classic Street Fighter arcade illustration. A large cobalt fighter jet in side profile fills the middle background, yellow/white sky, orange-red runway stripes. Graphic cel-animation key art with deliberately chunky pixel accents, heroic diagonals and economical detail. Integrate Claude and Codex data as TWO HUGE CREAM AVIATION STENCIL PANELS across the aircraft fuselage, left and right, with dark crisp text: CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT, CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT. Round fuel-gauge motifs may echo these proportions but don't add numbers. Guile is foreground left/centre below the panels; the white/yellow sonic crescent frames rather than obscures the typography. Make the aircraft, figure and label composition feel like one collectible arcade poster, not an infographic.

name: Select Your Fighter
direction: Roster portraits and two oversized selection cards.
detail: Composition: a beautifully crisp 1990s pixel-art CHARACTER SELECT screen. Top title "SELECT YOUR FIGHTER" in large yellow arcade lettering. A compact central row of six recognizable head portraits (Ryu, Ken, Chun-Li, Guile, Blanka, Dhalsim) in thick outlined square tiles, only ONE row; selected white/red corner brackets around Ryu and Chun-Li. Beneath, TWO HUGE SELECTION CARDS dominate the lower half, one blue/red portrait close-up and one cream number field each: left selected Ryu with CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT, right selected Chun-Li with CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT. White background with sparse cobalt world-map silhouette and red/yellow geometric framing. Rich sprite craftsmanship, large type, restrained density. Show tiny "1P" and "2P" near corresponding selections. Avoid a cluttered grid of extra portraits; the usage numbers and two selected faces are the focal point. Strict flat seven-ink treatment with pixel-shaped shading.

name: Continue?
direction: The arcade continue screen reimagined as a reserve-credits poster.
detail: Composition: the iconic arcade CONTINUE? moment as a witty bold 1990s pixel-art poster. Huge red-and-yellow "CONTINUE?" lettering across the top. A large, non-graphic exhausted Ryu portrait on the lower left, tousled hair, loosened red headband and white gi, determined expression; Chun-Li at lower right looks poised and ready. No injuries, blood, countdown or invented credit counts. Two giant cream-and-black arcade score windows occupy the middle, integrated into the chunky cabinet-game lettering: CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT on the left and CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT on the right. A yellow-white starburst behind the stronger right side visually contrasts the nearly depleted left side. Small bottom caption "ANOTHER ROUND" is allowed. Distinctive poster composition: oversized type, expressive pixel faces, clear bright paper background, seven-flat-ink style. This is a full-screen image, not a depiction of an arcade cabinet.
